name: select
title: Select
purpose: Choose one or more values from a finite, typed option list.

composition.styling: Consumer class and style attributes merge onto the combobox trigger while shared helpers preserve the Balsa field language.
composition.popup: The listbox uses the browser top layer when available so overflow containers do not clip it. Its option rows retain one fixed height with a small gap between rows; selected material uses 80% opacity without changing row geometry.
composition.multiple: Set multiple to keep the listbox open while selected options are toggled and emit an array model.
composition.customContent: Typed selected and option slots can add concise visual context while the option label remains the accessible selection identity.

accessibility: Associates its label, hint, and validation feedback with the trigger.
Implements combobox and listbox keyboard behavior.
Multiple mode exposes aria-multiselectable and keeps the listbox open while Enter or Space toggles the active option.
Invalid state exposes aria-invalid and an alert message.
The top-layer listbox remains structurally associated with its trigger.
commonMistakes: Using Select when Autocomplete is needed.
Omitting a stable id and visible label.
